full_judgment: 19. Fourth reason is based on the presumption that there must be procedure in the Code for punishing a judgment-debtor in case he violates a prohibitory decree, otherwise it will be practically useless to obtain a decree for permanent injunction. The Code, as already stated, is not and cannot be exhaustive. In all civilized countries, it is found, despite the best laws, residium of injustice will remain. Let us take the case of declaratory decree. Their effectiveness of execution depends on the good sense of the judgment-debtor. The decree-holder of a prohibitory decree, of course, has the remedy in a separate suit.
